---
glimpse(penguins)

---

```{r}
penguins |> ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x=body_mass,fill=species), bins = 100)
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
glimpse(penguins)
```
```{r}
penguins |> gf_point(body_mass ~ flipper_len, color = ~ year)
```
```{r}
penguins |> gf_point(body_mass ~ flipper_len, color = ~ species)
```
```{r}
penguins |> ggplot() + geom_boxplot((aes(x=body_mass, y=species)))
```
```{r}
library(skimr)
skim(penguins)
```
```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot(aes(flipper_len, body_mass, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ island)
```
```{r}
penguins |> gf_bar(~ species, fill = ~ island)
```

```{r}
penguins |> gf_bar(~ species, fill = ~ island, position = "dodge")

```
```{r}
penguins |> gf_bar(~ species, fill = ~ island, position = "dodge") |> gf_facet_wrap(~ factor(sex))
```

```{r}
penguins |> gf_density(~ body_mass, bins=50, fill =~ species)
```
